name: EPIC 211540619
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 11.9 solar radii and 0.98 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211540619 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.850458 (16th-84th percentiles 11.110176-13.007067), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 6,708 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.98 solar masses and 11.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,773 K at its surface.
